draft_notice: DRAFT, NOT FROZEN. No formal benchmark sample has been built, preflighted or run from this file. It is the editable template of the predeclared WP-12 Phase 5 benchmark (spec 5.1-5.8). Before any formal run the orchestrator (1) fills configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v1.json after the Phase 4 xhigh envelope decision, (2) re-declares the ID ranges inside that envelope, (3) copies this file to configs/wp12_benchmark_v1.json with status FROZEN and commits it (generalization_wp12.freeze_problems must return no problem). Development runs (artifacts/wp12/phase5_dev_NNN) use only the dev seeds and are labelled DEV; held-out seeds are never used for tuning.
spec: docs/WP12_SPECIFICATION.md Phase 5 (5.1 families, 5.2 randomization, 5.3 feasibility classes, 5.4 ID/OOD, 5.5 protocol, 5.6 metrics, 5.7 targets, 5.8 mixed operations)
frozen_and_unchanged: tlmpm*.py and law 8, every goals.py threshold (rcs_goal_v1 defaults, snapshot below), goal_eval_v1/v2/v2a, blade_master_flat_board_v1, final_v4, the WP-11 records. The benchmark only composes existing scene and goal types; the solver has no task-specific branch.

common.board_rule: Every scene is one continuous cutting board on the table (supports.kind flat_board). The board is CO-ROTATED with the workpiece (cutting_board.yaw_deg = workpiece yaw: flat_board_v1 has no oriented TLMPM fixture boxes) and its centre stays at the record value, so a yaw that turns a board corner past the table edge is scene_geometrically_infeasible. The workpiece z is the board top (flat_board_workcell.place_on_board). Slotted boards only where a family declares board_kind.

slotted_rule.text: Explicit Option D (ADR 0017, E1): one 8 mm wide, 8 mm deep through-width groove under each declared cut plane (its x at the board top), board stays one body.

solver.rule: tlmpm_v5 law 8 for every digit count (packed codes; needed by cut_aware_surface_v1), max_cuts = goal_planner digits_used, slots_per_node 16 (WP-11 round 2: no overflow, max occupancy 8)

duration_rule.text: WP-11 Phase E rule: probe compile, plan end = first DONE knot of the ideal reference schedule, duration = ceil((plan end + 1 s) / 0.5 s) * 0.5 s

dimension_rule.text: WP-11 Phase E rule: lengths and widths to even millimetres, heights (and trim depths) to whole millimetres; raw draws and applied values are both recorded

common.cut_plane_rule: WP-11 Phase E rule: vertical, unyawed sever planes are snapped to solver node planes (multiples of grid_dx_m in the workpiece frame); tilted or yawed planes are not snapped

sever_rule.text: WP-11 Phase E rule: minimum_part_mass_fraction = 0.5 x the smallest nominal piece fraction; every other sever threshold is the goals.py default

board_friction.scope: PhysX knife/robot-board contact only (Native); TLMPM material-board contact always uses the material friction (configs/wp12_workcells_v1.json friction_scope). No effect in kinematic runs; recorded as such.

board_kind.maps_to: cutting_board.kind (+ slots under the cut planes)

cut_order.maps_to: plane order of a multi-plane sever

slice_jitter_m.maps_to: offset of each equal-spacing slice plane

cut_tilt_deg.maps_to: sever normal tilt about local y (tau)

cut_plane_yaw_deg.maps_to: sever normal yaw about local z

advance_tilt_deg.maps_to: sever approach_local tilt in the plane

cut_clearance_m.maps_to: planner cut_clearance_m (armed start before the material)

material_profile.spec: Material profile, friction coefficients, mass/density, cutting resistance
material_profile.scope: Only discrete profiles are expressible in rcs_scene_v1: cutting_tasks_v1 and materials_wp12_v1 (Phase 4c, provisional, uncalibrated): soft_elastic / clay_plastic / firm / stiff (material), low/high_friction (friction), light/dense (density), low/high_cut_resistance (cutting resistance). wp12_stiff_v1 is refused at 0.1 ms by the CFL admission rule (physically_unsupported).

unsupported_dimensions.contact_parameters: TLMPM contact stiffness / radius are solver config, not scene data (generalization_wp12.MISSING_FEATURES continuous_physics_overrides)
unsupported_dimensions.continuous_friction_density_cut_resistan: only as discrete materials_wp12_v1 profiles (MISSING_FEATURES continuous_physics_overrides)

workpiece_yaw_deg.note: board co-rotated; corners leave the table beyond about 3.2 deg

skim_direction.note: DEV finding phase5_dev_001: -x skims (C s53901) and -x chip sweeps (G s57901) are collision/IK infeasible on this workcell, so -x is OOD

G.name: cut_push_relocation
G.spec: 5.1 G, 5.8 cut->push, trim->clear chip and cut->reposition->cut (sever x1, kerf_face push by d, sever reference x2 = midpoint(x1, L/2) with the opt-in step field planner_offset_local_m [d, 0, 0]; WP-12 Phase 6)

H.name: shape_pose_support_variation
H.spec: 5.1 H (declares the explicit slotted variant through board_kind)

seeds.rule: seed = family seed_base + split offset + range-set offset + i, i < count; every (family, seed) is unique over splits and range sets (checked at load). Declared seeds keep their declared index (variant = variants[index % len], OOD dimension = ood_dimensions[index % len]).

use.dev: research iteration and DEV smokes only (artifacts/wp12/phase5_dev_NNN)
use.benchmark: the formal run, once, after the freeze
use.held_out: run once after the benchmark with the frozen configuration; never used for tuning

sampling.ood_coverage_rule: With one_at_a_time, a family's OOD stratum must reach every declared OOD dimension with its 10 benchmark seeds (generalization_wp12.coverage; freeze_problems blocks otherwise), so each family declares at most 5 OOD dimensions per variant. Dimensions randomized only in ID: C skim_speed/protrusion_family/material_profile, E protrusion_family/radius_x, H workpiece_x/y, board_length, board_friction (PhysX only), protrusion_family; the material OOD axis is family A (and the separate Phase 4c material study).
sampling.ood_rule: An OOD sample takes every ID draw and replaces exactly one OOD dimension (ood_dimensions[index % len]) by its OOD range (disjoint from ID by validation), so each OOD outcome is attributable to one dimension (ood_boundary_by_dimension in the summary).

feasibility.checks: 1 scene geometry: generator checks (plane inside the workpiece, plane spacing >= 2 grid cells, separately removed protrusions do not overlap, sever planes miss protrusions where declared) then scene_config validation and compile (SceneInfeasible, flat-board record errors such as a board corner past the table edge, planner geometry errors); 2 supported envelope (configs/wp12/supported_envelope_v1.json; null bounds are NOT_EVALUATED and mark the sample envelope_pending; materials_wp12 CFL admission); 3 motion preflight (generalization.staged_preflight staged_v2: Newton IK, C2 MuJoCo distances, flat-board blade/board rule): IK pose error or joint-limit/continuity -> ik_unreachable, any collision/clearance check -> collision_constrained. The primary class is the first failing class in the precedence; all check results are kept. A config error or a preflight crash is a classification error: reported as not_run with the reason, never dropped.
feasibility.after_execution: valid_feasible -> task_success | execution_failure (solver_invalid, plan_not_finished, integrity, outcome, crash, grasp) | not_run (feasible but not executed: stays in the feasible denominator)

selection.text: Declared before any run: per stratum, the first 3 valid_feasible benchmark samples in declared seed order (feasibility classes only, never kinematic outcomes). A stratum with fewer than 3 valid_feasible samples runs what it has and records the shortfall; every unselected sample keeps its reason.

native.runner: scripts/run_wp12_phase5.py native-launch -> scripts/run_wp10_live.py --runtime isaac_sim --scene/--goal (the WP-12 Phase 2b workcell_live_v1 path: physical grasp, HOME reset, goal planner, measured edge feedback, hold to the time limit, physical return home)

kinematic.runner: scripts/run_wp12_phase5.py kinematic (one sample per process) / queue (resumable: a sample whose output directory exists is skipped and preserved)

task_outcome.target_removal_fraction: remove/trim: min removed mass fraction over selected protrusions or the region (generalization.episode_metrics cut_completion)
task_outcome.piece_displacement: move_piece displacement along the direction and the other pieces' maximum displacement
task_outcome.cutting_location_error: frozen 2 mm midpoint statistic (grid-aligned) or actual - ideal swept-plane statistic (oblique)
task_outcome.goal_completion: goal evaluator verdict (goal_eval_v2a integrity / outcome / quality layers)

physical_quality.substrate_retention: min substrate share over removal steps
physical_quality.remaining_unwanted_bridges: failed separation checks and component count vs expected
physical_quality.contact_stability: finite state, min det F, max particle speed (sampled every 10 control steps)
physical_quality.knife_grasp_stability: Native only (grasp monitor); NOT_APPLICABLE in kinematic runs
physical_quality.penetration: particles below the rigid board top, min local z, workspace-clamped control steps
physical_quality.physical_cutting_validity: evaluation integrity layer and solver validity (slot overflow, non-finite state)

runtime.gpu_memory: process GPU memory (nvidia-smi) at the end

reliability.multi_episode_stability: Phase 6 (repeated episodes per env); here: every sample is a fresh process
reliability.recorded_output_validity: result.json, manifest.json and actions.jsonl present and parseable
reliability.reproducibility: declared repeats: the first valid_feasible ID sample of each family rerun once on the other device; verdict and component count compared

thresholds.source: Each goal's declared thresholds: the rcs_goal_v1 defaults of goals.py (_TYPE_FIELDS) unchanged, plus the WP-11 Phase E sever_rule for minimum_part_mass_fraction (common.sever_rule). The snapshot below is checked against goals.py by the CPU tests; any drift blocks the freeze.

targets.other: No silent solver failures, no false-positive task success, no hidden sample exclusion (summaries assert every declared sample is counted once). OOD has no target: the boundary is measured.

budget.benchmark_candidates: 8 families x (ID + OOD) x 10 = 160 feasibility candidates; held-out 80; dev 32
budget.feasibility_cpu: about 10-25 s per sample (WP-11 Phase E stage 1): about 1.5 CPU-h for benchmark + held-out
budget.kinematic_gpu: about 3-15 min per valid_feasible episode on a shared GPU (WP-11 Phase E 2-24 min): <= 40 GPU-h worst case for 240 episodes; declared cap 30 GPU-h and 24 h wall on cuda:0 + cuda:1, at most 2 jobs per device
budget.native: 16 strata x 3 = 48 episodes, about 20-40 min each, one at a time: <= 32 h wall; declared cap 36 h
budget.if_over_budget: Decided before the freeze, never after results: e.g. OOD strata Native k = 3 only for families A, C, H; never drop declared samples from the feasibility stage.

mixed_operations.cut_reposition_cut: G cut_reposition_cut (sequence[sever, move_piece kerf_face, sever with the opt-in step field planner_offset_local_m = declared push]; generalization_wp12.IMPLEMENTED_FEATURES, WP-12 Phase 6)
mixed_operations.checks: cut history persists and earlier cuts stay valid (goal_eval_v2a per-step scopes + final all-digit substrate check), cut indices = goal_planner digit allocation cross-checked with goals.step_digit_allocation, no accidental reconnection (final components >= components after each step, read from the recorded history), evaluator scopes each operation (v2a), robot and tool valid (preflight + workspace clamp counts; Native grasp monitor)
